title: Using the derby mute
summary: They discuss how trumpeters held and used the derby mute and the origin of the wah-wah effect.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from

blocks.x: If you can't think of it, you can't think of it. No, I can't think of it. What about the Derby? How did the trumpet players use the Derby? Did they just hold it? Hold it, hold it.

Hold it in one hand, yeah. Ping-dip trumpet, you see.
